name: latex-math
description: Draws display LaTeX formulas ($$...$$ and \[...\]) as images in the Claude Code terminal (Ghostty, kitty, tmux with passthrough)

color.title: Formula color
color.description: auto picks light or dark gray for the Claude Code theme; a hex color such as #adbac7 matches your terminal's text color

size.title: Formula size
size.description: Formula size relative to the default, which is a little larger than terminal text at common font sizes
